segments.comment: A debug Knight rides his starting pony (#ride, forcing the mount), wishes for a wand of death, and fills every free square of the level with 1000 peaceful newts through #wizgenesis. He then zaps the wand at himself, accepts death and saves bones. bones.c savebones() calls steed.c dismount_steed(DISMOUNT_BONES), which puts the pony on the hero's square; enexto() finds no room, so it calls rloc(RLOC_ERR|RLOC_NOMSG), which finds no square either and prints teleport.c's impossible("rloc(): couldn't relocate monster") with "Program in disorder!" and the report line. Seed, clock, character and keys were chosen for this path.
